newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares flat, financial sectors firm.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares flat, financial sectors firm.

text.p: The Oslo bourse was flat on Wednesday as gains in smaller companies largely offset declines in the heavyweight blue chips, brokers said.

The Total share index closed 0.02 percent off at 869.29 points. Turnover picked up more than 30 percent from a day-earlier to 694 million crowns, with shipping group Wilh. Wilhelmsen accounting for 192 million crowns.

The banking and insurance sectors showed positive sentiment ahead of a ream of results due on Thursday when Den norske Bank, Fokus Bank and Sparebanken NOR are scheduled to post third quarter figures along with insurer Vital.
The banking index traded up 0.65 percent to 79.39 points while the insurance index added one percent to 373.27 points.
Telecommunications group Nera ASA attracted high interest and powered ahead as investors remained confident of management forecasts of a good performance in the fourth quarter.
Nera peaked at 232 crowns before settling six crowns, or nearly three percent, higher at 230 crowns in turnover of 52 million crowns.
"Third-quarter results were disappointing, but their order backlog for the fourth quarter is strong and the market is predicting tremendous growth in 1997," said an analyst.
